shortDescription: German reinsurer Munich Re XETR:MUV2 on Friday posted better-than-expected net profit in the third quarter and raised its full-year profit guidance.($1 = 0.8932 euros)

children: on Friday posted better-than-expected net profit in the third quarter and raised its full-year profit guidance.
It now sees full-year net profit of €6.6 billion ($7.4 billion), up from previous expectations of €6.3 billion
Munich Re also said net profit in the third quarter was around €1.7 billion, ahead of analyst expectations of €1.479 billion
The reinsurer attributed the strong quarter in part to lower-than-expected major loss claims and a strong investment result
Munich Re made the unscheduled announcement ahead of its detailed earnings planned for November 12
